docs.summary:
This study is open to adults who are at least 18 years old living with obesity and have:

* a confirmed liver disease called non-alcoholic steatohepatitis (NASH)/metabolic associated steatohepatitis (MASH) and

docs.summary:
The purpose of this study is to measure the difference in time to developing or worsening memory, thinking, or functional problems due to Alzheimer's disease occurring in participants receiving study drug compared to placebo.

docs.summary:

docs.summary:
The goal of this clinical trial is to learn if stem cell therapy works to treat brain inflammation in adults. Inflammation in the brain may be involved in adults who have memory or thinking problems. Because white cells play a role in immune function, people with CLL/SLL may be at greater risk of infections. CLL/SLL can be controlled with drugs, but many people develop resistance, and the treatments stop working.

To test a new drug (nemtabrutinib) in people with CLL/SLL.

docs.title: First-in-human Study of the Safety, Tolerability, Pharmacokinetics, and Food Effect of ACCG-2671
docs.sponsor: Aconcagua Bio, Inc. a wholly owned subsidiary of Structure Therapeutics
docs.summary: This first-in-human study will evaluate the safety, tolerability, and pharmacokinetics of single and multiple ascending oral doses of ACCG-2671. It will also evaluate the effect of food on the pharmacokinetics, safety, and tolerability of a single dose. Parts 1 and 2 will enroll healthy participants, and Part 3 will enroll otherwise healthy participants with obesity.

docs.summary:

docs.sponsor: National Heart, Lung, and Blood Institute (NHLBI)
docs.summary:
Background:

Waldenstrom macroglobulinemia (WM) is a type of blood cancer. It causes the blood to get thicker, which slows circulation and makes it harder to carry oxygen and other substances around the body. docs.title: A Study to Investigate the Effect of LY4086940 Versus Placebo in Participants With Obesity or Overweight and Without Type 2 Diabetes
docs.summary:
The purpose of this study, performed under the master protocol W8M-MC- CWMM (NCT06143956), is to evaluate the efficacy and safety of LY4086940 compared with placebo in participants without type 2 diabetes who have obesity or who have overweight with a weight-related health condition.

Participation in the study will last about 58 weeks.

docs.title: A Study of PLS240 in Pediatric Participants With Secondary Hyperparathyroidism and Chronic Kidney Disease on Hemodialysis
docs.summary:
Approximately 56 participants who are 1 month old to 17 years old will be enrolled in this study. The total duration for this study will be 38 weeks (or up to 42 weeks when participants require a washout period due to prior exposure to prohibited medications) and includes the following periods:

* Active screening period of 6 weeks (or, up to 10 weeks for participants requiring a washout period).
* Treatment period of 28 weeks consisting of a 19-week dose titration period and 9-week stable dose period.
* Safety follow-up period of 4 weeks.

docs.title: A Study of Bimagrumab in Participants With HFpEF
docs.summary: This study will look at how bimagrumab affects adults who have a type of heart failure called HFpEF (heart failure with preserved ejection fraction), where the heart pumps normally but does not fill with blood as well as it should. Participation in the study will last about 76 weeks.

docs.title: A Single-arm Phase II Clinical Trial of Camrelizumab in Combination With Nab-paclitaxel and Levcetirizine in Recurrent or Metastatic TNBC
docs.sponsor: Sun Yat-Sen Memorial Hospital of Sun Yat-Sen University
docs.summary: This is a phase II, explorative, multi-centered, single-arm, investigator-initiated clinical trial of Camrelizumab (an anti-PD-1 antibody) in combination with Nab-paclitaxel (a chemotherapeutic agent against breast cancer) and Levocetirizine (an antihistamine) in patients with metastatic or recurrent triple-negative breast cancer. 59 subjects will be enrolled in multiple centers. This study aims to evaluate the effects of Camrelizumab combined with Nab-paclitaxel and Levocetirizine in the treatment of metastatic or recurrent TNBC.
